name: Rise of the Outcast Hero
source: Embark on an unforgettable journey where a protagonist with no memory awakens in a mysterious forest. Guided by a wary elf, you discover a world divided between humans and demihumans. To earn trust, engage in quests within the demihuman territory, forging alliances and exploring romance. Unravel the mysteries of your past while navigating a delicate balance between love and looming conflict. In this captivating adventure, every choice shapes your destiny and the fate of a fractured world on the brink of war.​
translation: 失去记忆的主角在神秘的森林中苏醒，踏上难忘的旅程。在一个警惕的精灵的引导下，你发现了一个分为人类和亚人的世界。为了赢得信任，请在亚人领地内进行任务、结成联盟并探索浪漫。揭开你过去的秘密，同时在爱情和迫在眉睫的冲突之间寻求微妙的平衡。在这场引人入胜的冒险中，每一个选择都会塑造你的命运以及处于战争边缘的破碎世界的命运。
